reason: Ten stores minimum on a 12-month contract is almost a million pesos committed, and we just had a slow quarter. I can't walk into the board asking for that from a new company with zero customer results and no payback number.
objection: Nobody has proven the simulation actually predicts sales in a real store. If the suggestions are wrong, I've locked us into a year of paying for it and I'm the one who recommended it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or paid-on-results pilot in 3 to 5 of our stores with a proper control group that shows the sales lift in pesos covers the fee, and no 12-month lock-in until it does.
